summary: Refund batches receive complete pure preflight before provider calls or any line, timestamp or history mutation.
Refund quantities, paid totals and restock targets are validated; unsupported discounted refunds reject safely before the provider.
Checkout validates customer/cart/order and every inventory requirement before payment or reservation.
Idempotency records bind a normalized request fingerprint; changed identities conflict and legacy records fail closed, with an additive SQL upgrade supplied.
Production EF collection and domain-generated ID mappings are corrected, with explicit generic owned-money configuration.
Added pure-domain and real PostgreSQL handler regressions using a recording fake payment provider, plus an isolated test helper and nine learning guides.
limits: Provider success followed by failed database commit still requires reconciliation; exactly-once external financial processing is not implemented.
Discounted refunds require a future net allocation ledger and currently reject before provider invocation.
Request identity comparison and cart ownership consistency do not replace trusted customer authentication.
Existing databases require the provided additive fingerprint column upgrade; historical null fingerprints require reconciliation.

checks.command: Recorded complete suite and build/type checks
